messages:
marie: Quick sanity-check request — I'm about to merge a Terraform change that remaps secret paths for the staging->prod promote flow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

arun: quick skim done. main question: are we keeping old secret aliases for a transition window?

marie: plan is: create new path under /prod/apps/ -> write duplicate secrets, update k8s overlay to read new path, then flip consumer config via rollout. keep aliases for 3 days.

jae: small nit: in the overlay patch you're renaming configmap key `DB_CONN` -> `DATABASE_URL`. Any existing deployments relying on `DB_CONN` will break until rollout completes. suggest adding a fallback env var in the k8s manifest.

marie: good call. I'll add an env var with valueFrom secretKeyRef to old key for one release.

lina: did you run `terraform plan` against the staging workspace? last time we had a drift where secretsmanager path changed but k8s overlay still pointed to old secret name.

marie: ran plan locally, looks clean. attaching snippet of the changed resource: 

```
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "app_prod_v2" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.app_prod.id
  secret_string = jsonencode({
    DATABASE_URL = var.database_url
  })
}
```

arun: looks fine. double-check IAM permissions for the k8s service account — new path needs kms:Decrypt on the new alias.

diego: tagging SRE for the rollout window: @sre-bot please schedule a low-risk canary between 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow if infra changes approved. :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
notes: thread contains root message and replies; includes PR link and terraform snippet
